hypotheses.title: Completely Non-Templated Multi-Dataset Orthogonal Alphas
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Break completely free of repetitive formula shells and eliminate self-correlation bottlenecks across three distinct economic phenomena: (1) Forward Cash Flow Per Share Valuation (analyst4): Cash flow is far harder to manipulate than accounting earnings. Dividing consensus cash flow forecasts by price over a 180-day time-series window captures pure fundamental valuation without any technical overlay. (2) Inverted Supply Chain Lead-Lag Rebound (pv13): Major customer return shocks induce short-term overreaction in suppliers. Inverting the signal and smoothing across 20 trading days captures supplier mean-reversion with low turnover and zero portfolio overlap. (3) Implied Volatility Term Structure Slope (option8): Contango in implied volatility (90d IV > 30d IV) captures institutional risk-premia harvesting and calm market conditions, while backwardation reflects event-driven distress.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if consensus cash flow forecasts do not predict equity returns or if inverted supply chain signals face structural customer bankruptcy.
